name: Cowleys Pest Services
what_they_do: Family-owned New Jersey pest control company (founded 1991 by Drew Cowley) doing residential and commercial pest control - termites, rodents, bed bugs, ants, mosquitoes/ticks, wildlife and bird control - plus attic insulation, crawl-space encapsulation, gutter guards and mold removal. Sells tiered service plans (Silver/Gold/Platinum) with a 6-step program, and offers a Spotswood-located service page.
customers: Homeowners and commercial property managers in Mercer, Ocean, Monmouth, Somerset and Middlesex counties.

size_signals.signal: Multiple service lines (pest, wildlife, insulation, crawl space), tiered service plans, Meet the Team directory, careers page and multi-county service area - a regional company, not a one-van operator
Founded 1991, family-owned; clients can log into a client portal, and the site runs SMS appointment notifications

listing.platform: Google (5.0 across 659 reviews, aggregated on Birdeye); town page also carried on the company's own Spotswood page

website_review.primary_cta: 'Call Now' sticky header bar (click-to-call) plus 'Contact Us For A Free Estimate' form on every town page
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Free-estimate form (First/Last Name, Street, City, State, Zip, Phone, Email, 'What prompted you' dropdown, concerns textarea, SMS consent checkbox) - 9 required fields, no CAPTCHA; no calendar booking, and clients use a separate Client Login portal
website_review.trust_signals: 659 Google reviews at 5.0, founded-1991 story, Meet the Team, awards, affiliations/partners, before/after galleries, videos, case studies, technical papers, client portal
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Nothing material: copyright current, navigation deep, blog active. Hours are not printed on the home page or the town page (the schema omits openingHours)
website_review.search_basics: Strong: dedicated Spotswood page with its own title ('Pest Control Company | Wildlife Removal Services in Spotswood, NJ') and matching meta description; per-pest pages and per-town pages exist; schema present (Place, Organization, 4x HomeAndConstructionBusiness, BreadcrumbList)
top_issues: No online scheduling: the only async path is a 9-field estimate form, so a customer who wants a specific appointment slot must phone
Home page loads zero forms and the business schema has no openingHours or priceRange, and no plan prices are published anywhere
No CAPTCHA on the form is good for agents, but the form asks for a full postal address before any conversation, which is a high-friction first step for mobile users

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt only blocks /search.html and tracking query strings - OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot all allowed; sitemap present; huge review base and a claimed profile implied by the town pages. Answerable: services, towns, service plans and phone are real text and there is a full schema @graph, but openingHours and priceRange are absent and plan pricing is unpublished. Bookable: the labelled, CAPTCHA-free estimate form is a genuine agent-reachable quote path with 9 required fields, but there is no calendar, so booking still ends in a human callback.

operations_signals.signal: SMS consent text on the estimate form ('appointment setting, account notifications, customer care') shows reminders and follow-up are already semi-automated - work exists but is vendor-run
Multiple service lines and tiered plans per homeowner mean high inbound volume that must be triaged to the right division (pest vs insulation vs wildlife)
Careers page and Meet the Team directory suggest staffing scale where scheduling/admin load is a real cost (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add real online scheduling for the free estimate / first service visit (slot picker feeding their dispatch), so a booking no longer needs a callback
top_opportunities.evidence: Only intake is a 9-field estimate form plus 'Call Now'; no calendar anywhere and a separate client login for existing customers

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish plan pricing and service-plan comparison as text and add openingHours/priceRange to the existing schema, so an agent can answer 'what will this cost' without escalating
top_opportunities.evidence: No dollar amounts appear on the Spotswood page or home page; schema @graph has business types but no hours or price

top_opportunities.opportunity: Qualification agent on the estimate form: ask the two or three questions that decide division and plan, then route to the right crew calendar
top_opportunities.evidence: One generic form serves pest, wildlife, insulation and crawl-space enquiries across five counties, with only a free-text 'describe your concerns' field

scores.reasons: Gap: polished marketing site with schema and 659 reviews - the gaps are narrow (no scheduling, no published pricing, no hours in markup). Pay: multi-county, 30+ year family company with recurring plan revenue and existing vendors, so budget clearly exists. Ease: a one-person consultancy would be selling into an established marketing operation, so procurement and integration are slower. Evidence: site, forms, schema and reviews all inspected directly.
